************************** ITURHFP Input Parameters *****************************

******************************** Data Format ***********************************

Column 01: Month
Column 02: Hour
Column 03: Frequency (MHz)
Column 04: Receiver latitude (deg)
Column 05: Receiver longitude (deg)
Column 06: D - Path distance (km)
Column 07: dmax - Path maximum hop distance (km)
Column 08: ptick - Slant Path distance (km)
Column 09: ele - Path minimum Rx elevation angle (deg)
Column 10: BMUF - Path basic MUF (MHz)
Column 11: MUF50 - 50% Path basic MUF (MHz)
Column 12: MUF90 - 90% Path basic MUF (MHz)
Column 13: MUF10 - 10% Path basic MUF (MHz)
Column 14: OPMUF - Operation MUF (MHz)
Column 15: OPMUF90 - 90% Operation MUF (MHz)
Column 16: OPMUF10 - 10% Operation MUF (MHz)
Column 17: Lowest order mode for the F2 layer
Column 18: Lowest order mode for the E layer
Column 19: E - Path Field Strength (dB(1uV/m))
Column 20: Pr - Median receiver power (dB)
Column 21: Grw - Receive Antenna Gain (dbi)
Column 22: FaA - Atmospheric noise (dB)
Column 23: FaM - Man-made noise (dB)
Column 24: FaG - Galactic noise (dB)
Column 25: DuA - Upper decile deviation of atmospheric noise (dB)
Column 26: DlA - Lower decile deviation of atmospheric noise (dB)
Column 27: DuM - Upper decile deviation of man-made noise (dB)
Column 28: DlM - Lower decile deviation of man-made noise (dB)
Column 29: DuG - Upper decile deviation of atmospheric noise (dB)
Column 30: DlG - Lower decile deviation of atmospheric noise (dB)
Column 31: DuT - Upper decile deviation of total noise (dB)
Column 32: DlT - Lower decile deviation of total noise (dB)
Column 33: FamT - Total noise (dB)
Column 34: SNR - Median signal-to-noise ratio (dB)
Column 35: DuSN - Upper decile deviation of signal-to-noise ratio (dB)
Column 36: DlSN - Lower decile deviation of signal-to-noise ratio (dB)
Column 37: SNRXXp - Signal-to-noise ratio at 99% of month
Column 38: SIR - Signal-to-interference ratio (dB)
Column 39: DuSI - Upper decile deviation of signal-to-interference ratio (dB)
Column 40: DlSI - Lower decile deviation of signal-to-interference ratio (dB)
Column 41: RSN - Probability that the required SNR is achieved (%)
Column 42: RT - Probability that the required time spread T0 is not exceeded (%)
Column 43: RF - Probability that the required frequency spread f0 is not exceeded (%)
Column 44: BCR - Basic circuit reliability (%)
Column 45: OCR - Overall circuit reliability not considering scattering (%)
Column 46: OCRs - Overall circuit reliability considering scattering (%)
Column 47: Probocc - Probability of scattering (%)
Column 48: MIR - Multimode Interference (%)
Column 49: Dominant mode
Column 50: Dominant mode - Elevation angle (deg)
Column 51: Dominant mode - Delay (mS)
Column 52: Dominant mode - Loss (dB)
Column 53: Dominant mode - Propagation probability (%)
Column 54: Dominant mode - Virtual height (km)
Column 55: Dominant mode - Median received power (dB)
Column 56: Dominant mode - Receiver Antenna Gain (dBi)
Column 57: Dominant mode - Field Strength (dB(1uV/m))
Column 58: Dominant mode - Basic MUF (MHz)
Column 59: Short Path (<=7000 km) Field Strength (dB(1uV/m))
Column 60: Long Path (>9000km) Field Strength (dB(1uV/m))
Column 61: Free-space Field Strength 3 MW e.i.r.p. (dB(1uV/m)
Column 62: Increased Long Distance Field Strength due to Focusing (dB)
Column 63: "Not otherwise included loss" (dB)
Column 64: Upper Reference Frequency (MHz)
Column 65: Lower Reference Frequency (MHz)
Column 66: Correction Factor at T + d0/2
Column 67: Correction Factor at R - d0/2
Column 68: Max Antenna Gain G_tl (0 - 8 deg)
Column 69: Max Antenna Gain G_rw (0 - 8 deg)
Column 70: Mean gyrofrequency
Column 71: Scale factor f(f ,fL, fM, fH)

************************** End Data Format ********************************
